```{r}
libs <- c("tidyverse", "rlang", "cli")
pacman::p_load(char = libs)

    gss = forcats::gss_cat,
    sw  = dplyr::starwars,
    iris = datasets::iris

list2env(data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```
